description: Lawie prod/develop: allow-listed ops. No free-form shell. v5: + seed-setting. v6: key allows '-' and 'finance.'. v7: + nginx-access (path, lines; time/method/path/status only), + env-has (name; set/unset only, never the value). v8: deploy calls box-local scripts/deploy-local.sh when present (T-606), else the inline body.

runCommand: A='{{ action }}'; S='{{ service }}'; N='{{ lines }}'; B='{{ branch }}'; K='{{ key }}'; V='{{ value }}'; P='{{ path }}'; E='{{ name }}'
*) echo "refused: branch $B is not allowed on instance $IID"; exit 2 ;;
if ! git diff --quiet || ! git diff --cached --quiet; then echo 'refused: tracked files modified on the box:'; git status --short --untracked-files=no; exit 4; fi
[ -n "$ENVF" ] && [ -f "$ENVF" ] || { echo 'refused: env file named in ecosystem.config.js not found'; exit 3; }

ENVX=$(node --env-file="$ENVF" -e 'const q=v=>"\x27"+v.replace(/\x27/g,"\x27\\\x27\x27")+"\x27";for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(process.env)){if(/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(k))console.log("export "+k+"="+q(v))}') || { echo 'refused: env file could not be parsed'; exit 3; }
echo 'build packages'; yarn workspace @lawie/shared build; yarn workspace @lawie/email-client build
echo 'build services'; yarn workspaces run build
[ "$K" != ai.unset ] && [ "$V" != unset ] || { echo 'refused: key and value are required'; exit 2; }
[ -n "$ENVF" ] && [ -f "$ENVF" ] || { echo 'refused: env file named in ecosystem.config.js not found'; exit 3; }

ENVX=$(node --env-file="$ENVF" -e 'const q=v=>"\x27"+v.replace(/\x27/g,"\x27\\\x27\x27")+"\x27";for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(process.env)){if(/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(k))console.log("export "+k+"="+q(v))}') || { echo 'refused: env file could not be parsed'; exit 3; }
grep -F -- "$P" /var/log/nginx/access.log | tail -n "$N" | awk '{t=$4; sub(/^\[/,"",t); m=$6; sub(/^"/,"",m); u=$7; sub(/\?.*$/,"",u); print t, m, u, $9}'
[ "$E" != UNSET ] || { echo 'refused: name is required'; exit 2; }
[ -n "$ENVF" ] && [ -f "$ENVF" ] || { echo 'refused: env file named in ecosystem.config.js not found'; exit 3; }
if [ "$c" -gt 0 ]; then echo "$E: set"; elif [ "$z" -gt 0 ]; then echo "$E: set but empty"; else echo "$E: unset"; fi

logs) if [ "$S" = all ]; then run_u "pm2 logs --lines $N --nostream"; elif run_u "pm2 describe $S >/dev/null 2>&1"; then run_u "pm2 logs $S --lines $N --nostream"; else echo "no pm2 process named $S on this box; processes:"; run_u 'pm2 status'; fi ;;

health) for p in 4000 4001 4002 4003 9100; do printf '%s ' $p; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:$p/health || true; done; printf '3000 / '; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:3000/ || true ;;
restart) if [ "$S" = all ]; then run_u 'cd ~/lawie && pm2 reload ecosystem.config.js --update-env'; else run_u "cd ~/lawie && pm2 reload ecosystem.config.js --only $S --update-env"; fi ;;

deploy) deploy_guard && if [ -f /home/ubuntu/lawie/scripts/deploy-local.sh ]; then echo 'deploy via scripts/deploy-local.sh'; sudo -u ubuntu -i bash /home/ubuntu/lawie/scripts/deploy-local.sh "$B"; else echo 'scripts/deploy-local.sh not on box: inline fallback'; deploy_run; fi ;;
